name: Lodha Developers Ltd
title: Lodha Developers Ltd - 543287 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Lodha guides FY27 presales ~INR240bn (mid-teens growth) with 32-34% embedded EBITDA margin, shifts focus to PAT (20% CAGR to >INR85bn by FY31) and cuts BD spend; supply discipline strong but Middle East shock caused March closure deferrals.

capex.quote: we expect that the investment into new business development will be muted over the next 2 years

triggers.label: BD investment muted next 2 years
triggers.quote: we expect that the investment into new business development will be muted over the next 2 years

triggers.label: FY27 presales ~INR240bn, margin 32-34%
triggers.quote: we are guiding to presales of about INR240 billion with an embedded EBITDA margin of 32% to 34%

triggers.label: 1GW data-centre powered shell plan
triggers.quote: we are now planning to develop about 1 gigawatt of powered shell capacity on a build -to-suit basis

triggers.label: Exiting FY26 with elevated unsold inventory
triggers.quote: So, you end the year with a higher elevated level of unsold inventory, but nothing out of the normal.

triggers.label: March closures deferred by Middle East shock
triggers.quote: March, which was the peak of the Middle East news cycle, did see select deferral of closures

guidance.quote: we are guiding to presales of about INR240 billion with an embedded EBITDA margin of 32% to 34%
we are guiding to presales of about INR240 billion with an embedded EBITDA margin of 32% to 34%

guidance.value: about 20% per annum from INR71 billion base
guidance.quote: we expect OCF to grow in line with PAT growth and therefore, grow at about 20% or thereabouts per annum

guidance.value: more than INR85 billion by FY31 (20% CAGR)
guidance.quote: moving from about INR34 billion for fiscal '26 to more than INR85 billion by fiscal '31

guidance.value: INR80 billion by FY30 (reiterated, possibly 12-month deferral)
guidance.quote: There may be 12 months of deferral on account of the delay in some of these infra projects.
The estimated annual rental income from these existing assets will be about INR10 billion by fiscal '31

prior_guidance_check.quote: Presales of INR205 billion, up 16% with every single quarter delivering its best ever performance.
We added 12 projects with INR600 billion of GDV, 2.4x, our own guidance.

red_flags.label: Unsold inventory elevated at FY26 exit
red_flags.quote: So, you end the year with a higher elevated level of unsold inventory, but nothing out of the normal.

red_flags.label: Labour attrition 5-10% over seasonal norms
red_flags.quote: Labour attrition in March, April is running at about 5% to 10% over seasonal norms.

evasions.quote: difficult for us to predict how this whole Middle East thing will pan out, etcetera.
presales as a guidance tool has been something, which is probably less reflective of the underlying health of the business.
